name: seats-coupon
title: Seats coupon
description: A 608 bearing's pocket at three printed clearances, from a press to a slip: print once per filament, press a bearing into each, and write the one that holds without cracking into the printer's rules (press and slip).

press_tight.rule: Row one: a tight press, printed clearance across

press_mid.rule: Row two: the press the printer's rules start from

slip.rule: Row three: a slip by hand

pitch.rule: Pockets apart, with a wall between that a pressed race doesn't crack

edge.rule: From a pocket's centre to the plate's edge

thick.rule: The plate: the bearing's width, the ledge and a floor to hold it

relief.rule: On through the plate past the ledge, so a bearing can be pushed back out

stroke.rule: One print line, for the figures
